topics.title: Limits from Tables and Graphs
topics.description: Practice Limits from Tables and Graphs through Determine Expressions and Values tasks using the local atomic question bank as scope evidence.

topics.title: Algebraic Evaluation of Limits
topics.description: Practice Algebraic Evaluation of Limits through Determine Expressions and Values tasks using the local atomic question bank as scope evidence.

topics.title: Continuity and the Intermediate Value Theorem
topics.description: Match the two sided limit to the function value and verify interval continuity. Confirm endpoints produce outputs that bracket the target before citing the Intermediate Value Theorem.

topics.title: Infinite Limits and Asymptotes
topics.description: Practice Infinite Limits and Asymptotes through Determine Expressions and Values tasks using the local atomic question bank as scope evidence.

topics.title: Derivative as a Limit
topics.description: Compute f′ at a point using a symmetric difference quotient. Confirm the numerical slope matches the analytic limit with correct units.

topics.title: Differentiability and Continuity
topics.description: Practice Differentiability and Continuity through Determine Expressions and Values tasks using the local atomic question bank as scope evidence.

topics.title: Basic Derivative Rules
topics.description: Name subexpressions then apply power, product, and quotient rules. Check domain restrictions and a squared quotient denominator.

topics.title: Higher-Order Derivatives
topics.description: Differentiate the given function the required number of times and track units after each step. Verify the chosen derivative matches the stated variable and rate before evaluating and interpreting.

topicGroups.title: Unit 3: Differentiation—Composite, Implicit, and Inverse Functions

topics.title: Chain Rule
topics.description: Practice Chain Rule through Determine Expressions and Values tasks using the local atomic question bank as scope evidence.

topics.title: Implicit Differentiation
topics.description: Practice Implicit Differentiation through Determine Expressions and Values tasks using the local atomic question bank as scope evidence.

topics.title: Derivatives of Inverse Functions
topics.description: Find x0 where f equals y0 and compute 1 over f prime at x0 with units. Confirm f prime at x0 exists, is nonzero, and units are correctly inverted.

topics.title: Exponential, Logarithmic, and Inverse Trigonometric Derivatives
topics.description: Practice Exponential, Logarithmic, and Inverse Trigonometric Derivatives through Determine Expressions and Values tasks using the local atomic question bank as scope evidence.

topics.title: Interpreting Derivatives in Context
topics.description: Identify input and output units, then state the instantaneous rate at the given input. Confirm units are output per input and the sign matches increasing or decreasing behavior.

topics.title: Related Rates
topics.description: Link variables with a constraint, implicitly differentiate in time, then substitute simultaneous values. Check units and use rates from the same moment only.

topics.title: Particle Motion
topics.description: Find velocity zeros, chart signs, and compare with acceleration. Split at every velocity sign change before integrating absolute value.

topics.title: Local Linearity and L'Hospital's Rule
topics.description: Practice Local Linearity and L'Hospital's Rule through Determine Expressions and Values tasks using the local atomic question bank as scope evidence.

topics.title: Mean Value and Extreme Value Theorems
topics.description: Confirm continuity on the closed interval and differentiability on the open interval, then compute the required values. Include endpoints for extremes and use interior points for mean value conclusions.

topics.title: Increasing, Decreasing, and Critical Points
topics.description: Solve f′ equals zero, mark critical points and endpoints, and test signs on each subinterval. Check domain endpoints and non differentiable points, and compute f values before declaring extrema.

topics.title: Concavity and Inflection Points
topics.description: Find domain points where the second derivative is zero or undefined, then check signs on both sides. Confirm concavity changes before naming an inflection.

topics.title: Optimization and Curve Analysis
topics.description: Model a one variable objective and evaluate critical points and endpoints. Confirm the domain and units before comparing values.

topicGroups.title: Unit 6: Integration and Accumulation of Change

topics.title: Riemann Sums
topics.description: Practice Riemann Sums through Determine Expressions and Values tasks using the local atomic question bank as scope evidence.

topics.title: Integration by Parts and Partial Fractions
topics.description: Identify a product or proper rational function, then apply integration by parts or decompose into partial fractions. Verify the fraction is proper and apply limits correctly.

topics.title: Definite Integrals and the Fundamental Theorem
topics.description: Recognize integrand as derivative of a named quantity and match limits to its domain endpoints. Ensure endpoint subtraction f(b) minus f(a) uses correct order and attaches appropriate units.

topics.title: Improper Integrals
topics.description: Express the improper integral as a limit and compute or compare. Verify each endpoint's limit exists and is finite before concluding convergence.

topics.title: Antiderivatives and Substitution
topics.description: Identify the inner function, set u, and rewrite the integrand and differential. Ensure du matches and change limits to u to avoid errors.

topics.title: Numerical Integration and Error Direction
topics.description: Compute trapezoidal or midpoint sums from the given table. State interval concavity and infer whether each approximation overestimates or underestimates.

topics.title: Slope Fields and Solution Curves
topics.description: Practice Slope Fields and Solution Curves through Determine Expressions and Values tasks using the local atomic question bank as scope evidence.

topics.title: Logistic Differential Equations
topics.description: Write the logistic form and solve for k using two observed P values. Check maximum growth occurs at half capacity to prevent wrong rate.

topics.title: Separable Differential Equations
topics.description: Separate y and x terms and integrate both sides. Use the initial condition to find C and choose the correct branch.

topics.title: Initial Conditions and Euler's Method
topics.description: Compute the slope at each left endpoint and update y by adding h times the slope. Verify the initial condition and keep a constant step size h throughout.

topics.title: Exponential Growth and Decay
topics.description: Write y equals Ce^{kt} and set dy over dt equals ky. Use rate and amount from the same time when solving for k.

topics.title: Average Value and Net Change
topics.description: Set the definite integral with correct bounds and units, then evaluate an antiderivative. Divide by interval length for average value, or report the signed result for net change.

topics.title: Area Between Curves
topics.description: Identify intersections, pick the top curve on each subinterval, then integrate top minus bottom. Verify interval splits and bounds, and swap order if the top function changes.

topics.title: Volumes with Cross Sections
topics.description: Compute side length as top minus bottom, then apply the equilateral area formula. Confirm the stated bounds and attach correct units.

topics.title: Disk and Washer Volumes
topics.description: Mark axis and interval, express radii as distances, then square and integrate with π. Verify outer minus inner matches axis and bounds, variable is correct, and units included.

topicGroups.title: Unit 9: Parametric Equations, Polar Coordinates, and Vector-Valued Functions

topics.title: Parametric Derivatives
topics.description: Practice Parametric Derivatives through Determine Expressions and Values tasks using the local atomic question bank as scope evidence.

topics.title: Polar Coordinates and Derivatives
topics.description: Differentiate x and y with respect to θ. Confirm dx/dθ is nonzero before dividing to form dy/dx.

topics.title: Second Derivatives of Parametric Curves
topics.description: Practice Second Derivatives of Parametric Curves through Determine Expressions and Values tasks using the local atomic question bank as scope evidence.

topics.title: Arc Length of Parametric and Vector Curves
topics.description: Practice Arc Length of Parametric and Vector Curves through Determine Expressions and Values tasks using the local atomic question bank as scope evidence.

topics.title: Vector-Valued Motion
topics.description: Differentiate r of t to obtain velocity and acceleration. Compute speed as the magnitude of velocity at that time with correct units.

topics.title: Polar Area
topics.description: Practice Polar Area through Determine Expressions and Values tasks using the local atomic question bank as scope evidence.

topics.title: Sequence Limits
topics.description: Divide numerator and denominator by the highest power of n to isolate leading coefficients. Ensure no undefined terms and verify with large-n values.

topics.title: Geometric and Telescoping Series
topics.description: Identify the common ratio or rewrite as differences to expose cancellation. Form partial sums and take limits, verifying |r|<1 and the remaining tail.

topics.title: Ratio and Root Tests
topics.description: Form absolute-value ratios or nth roots and compute the limit. Verify the limit uses dominant growth and compare strictly to one.

topics.title: Integral and p-Series Tests
topics.description: Rewrite terms as n to negative p or define f and compute an improper integral. Confirm f is positive and decreasing and match the integral's behavior to the series.

topics.title: Alternating Series and Error
topics.description: Practice Alternating Series and Error through Determine Expressions and Values tasks using the local atomic question bank as scope evidence.

topics.title: Taylor and Maclaurin Series
topics.description: Evaluate derivatives at the chosen center and divide by factorial to get coefficients. Confirm powers match the form and note truncation order.

topics.title: Comparison and Limit Comparison Tests
topics.description: Extract the dominant term and compare with a matching p-series or geometric benchmark. Confirm all terms are positive and the limit or inequalities satisfy the test.

topics.title: Power Series Intervals and Error
topics.description: Practice Power Series Intervals and Error through Determine Expressions and Values tasks using the local atomic question bank as scope evidence.
